subject: vt-att
title: VT.ATT.------IST.S.ALGN.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 455 (TRF(CW)-27). VT-ATT (vibrational attitude) is the subject; IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is the partner. From the subject: PER-DY (perception dynamics), RT-DY (reality dynamics) and UPB (underlying philosophical basis). From PER-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From RT-DY: APL-DT (application dictates). From APL-DT: INTR (interpretation). From UPB: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TM: P-FC (particular focus).
